sections.description:
LABOUR WELFARE STATISTICS (WEST PAKISTAN) RULES, 1963
LABOUR
WELFARE STATISTICS (WEST PAKISTAN) RULES, 1963
[Gaz. of West
Pak. Extr. 5 August 1963, p. 3637.]
[As in force in Baluchistan, N. W. F. P. and
Sind]
[No. 5‑3 (L‑II)/63, the 28th August 1963. Rules
framed by West Pakistan Government in exercise of the powers conferred by
section 12 read with section 5 of the Industrial Statistics Act, 1942, a draft
of which was published in the Gazette of West Pakistan, dated the 15th
April 1963, under notification No. 5‑3(L‑II)/53, dated the 9th
April 1963].
1. Short title and
commencement. ‑---
(I) These rules may be called the Labour Welfare Statistics (West Pakistan)
Rules, 1963.
(2) They shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions‑--- (1) In these rules, unless there is
anything repugnant in the subject or context, the following expressions shall
have the meanings hereby respectively assigned to them, that is to say‑‑
(a) "Act"
means the Industrial Statistics Act, 1942;
(b) "Form'"'
means a form appended to these rules;
(c) "Statistics Authority" means the authority
appointed as such under section 4 of the Act.
(2) Any expression used in These rules but
not herein defined shall have the same meaning as in the Factories Act, 1934
(XXV of 1334).
3. Service of notice by
Statistics Authority.‑--
(1) The notice to be served by or on behalf of the Statistics Authority under
section 5 of the Act, shall be in Form A .
(2) A notice meant for a Corporation may be
served on the Secre tary, or any Director, or other principal officer of the
Corporation, or by addressing it to the Corporation at its registered office,
and if it has no registered office, then at the principal place where the
Corporation carries on its business.
(3) A notice meant for a firm may be served
upon any one or more of the partners or upon any person having control or
management of the partnership business at the principal place at which the.
Partnership business is carried on, and such service shall be deemed good
service upon the firm, whether all or any of the partners are residing within
or without the Province of West Pakistan.
(4) A notice under these rules may be served
by registered post acknow ledgement due.
4. Submission of Returns.‑--- (1) Every Occupier of a Factory on whom
a notice has. been served under rule 3, shall furnish to the Statistics
Authority the following returns in duplicate on or before the date specified in
respect of each return
(a) A
quarterly return in duplicate in Form B for each quarter ending 31st
March, 30th June, 30th September and 31st
December on or before the 15th of the month, following the quarter
to which the return relates.
(b) An
annual return in duplicate in Form C on or before the 31st of
January, following the year to which it relates.
(2) Where a factory has worked for a part of
the year or a part of a quarter only, the return shall relate to such part
only.
(3) The returns shall be posted to the
Statistics Authority, Registered Acknowledgement due, in a closed cover marked
"Confidential Labour Statistics Return".
5. Extension of time for the
submission of Return.‑‑-- The Statistics Authority may in any special case, for reasons to be
recorded in writing, extend the period for submission of an annual Return upto
60 days.
6. Manner for the submission
of Returns.‑--- The
returns to be furnished under rule 4 shall conform to the directions set forth
in Appendix I in the case of quarterly returns and in Appendix II, in the case
of annual returns.
7. Relationship to other Rules
under Industrial Statistics Act, 1942. --- The returns to be furnished under these rules shall be in addition
to the returns to be furnished under the Industrial Statistics (West Pakistan)
Rules, 1960.
